purpose: Broaden genuine travel footage discovery without lowering editorial quality or creating a forced Reel.
environment: Local host requests+FFprobe+FFmpeg; not yet a GitHubActions provider delivery test.

samples.name: pixabay-6998
samples.visual_review: Dynamic waterfall close-up; portrait crop can retain water/spray but loses geographic context. Source identifies Iceland only; do not name waterfall without additional verification. Needs actual interval review, not automatically approved.
samples.inspection_scope: Three decoded timestamps plus landscape/centre-portrait comparison; not a completed moving-Reel or audio approval.

samples.name: mixkit-4062
samples.visual_review: Commercial-use Free licence confirmed, but delivered1280x720 timelapse is too soft for a default9:16 crop and centre crop excludes the distinctive tower/building. Reject this rendition for full-screen vertical production.
samples.inspection_scope: Three decoded timestamps plus landscape/centre-portrait comparison; not a completed moving-Reel or audio approval.

samples.name: coverr-costa-rica
samples.visual_review: Real original stock sunrise over water; centre portrait crop loses the sun at the right. Reframe deliberately or reject; generic sunset alone does not establish a destination story.
samples.inspection_scope: Three decoded timestamps plus landscape/centre-portrait comparison; not a completed moving-Reel or audio approval.

samples.name: coverr-indonesia
samples.visual_review: Original stock sunset/clouds; portrait crop is visually possible but offers little location-specific evidence. Do not fill a destination Reel with generic atmospheric clips.
samples.inspection_scope: Three decoded timestamps plus landscape/centre-portrait comparison; not a completed moving-Reel or audio approval.
